_comment: Style advisor knowledge base. Edit without touching Python.

black.explanation: Black is versatile and pairs with almost everything
black.tip: Use black as a grounding neutral

white.explanation: White is clean and fresh, pairs well with both bold and soft tones
white.tip: White sneakers work with any casual outfit

navy.explanation: Navy is a sophisticated neutral that replaces black in softer looks
navy.tip: Navy and white is a classic, fail-safe combination

red.explanation: Red is a statement colour — pair with neutrals to balance
red.tip: A red shoe can elevate an all-black or all-white outfit

blue.explanation: Blue tones work well with earth tones and neutrals
blue.tip: Light blue pairs beautifully with tan or beige shoes

green.explanation: Green pairs naturally with earth tones
green.tip: Olive green is especially versatile for casual looks

grey.explanation: Grey is the ultimate neutral — works with warm and cool tones
grey.tip: Grey shoes are as versatile as black but feel more relaxed

brown.explanation: Brown is warm and earthy — avoid pairing with black
brown.tip: Brown leather shoes pair perfectly with denim

beige.explanation: Beige is a warm neutral that softens any outfit
beige.tip: Beige sneakers are trending — they go with everything

pink.explanation: Pink adds a playful touch — balance with neutrals
pink.tip: Dusty pink is more wearable than hot pink for everyday

purple.explanation: Purple is bold — keep the rest of the outfit simple
purple.tip: Deep purple pairs well with grey for a sophisticated look

brand_size_notes.nike: Nike tends to run slightly narrow. If you have wide feet, consider going half a size up.
brand_size_notes.adidas: Adidas runs true to size for most models. Boost models may feel snug initially.
brand_size_notes.new balance: New Balance offers wide (2E) and extra-wide (4E) options. Great for wider feet.
brand_size_notes.puma: Puma generally runs true to size. Some models run slightly small.
brand_size_notes.reebok: Reebok runs true to size. Classic Leather runs slightly large.
brand_size_notes.asics: ASICS tends to run true to size. Gel models offer good arch support.
brand_size_notes.brooks: Brooks runs true to size. Known for excellent support and cushioning.
brand_size_notes.hoka: HOKA runs half a size small for many. Consider sizing up.
brand_size_notes.converse: Converse Chuck Taylors run about a full size large. Size down.
brand_size_notes.vans: Vans runs true to size for most models.
brand_size_notes.saucony: Saucony runs true to size. Comfortable out of the box.

foot_type_advice.wide: Look for brands that offer wide options: New Balance (2E/4E), ASICS, Brooks. Avoid narrow brands like Converse.
foot_type_advice.narrow: Nike and Adidas tend to run narrower. Avoid New Balance wide models.
foot_type_advice.flat: Look for stability shoes with arch support: Brooks Adrenaline, ASICS Gel-Kayano, New Balance 860.
foot_type_advice.high arch: Neutral cushioned shoes work best: HOKA Clifton, Brooks Ghost, ASICS Gel-Nimbus.
foot_type_advice.normal: Most standard-width shoes will work well. Focus on the activity type.
